svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crossbeam 1650 of SHS; two legs 94 of SHS at its ends, welded.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot plates 100 x 100 x 6 under the legs; EPDM pads glued under.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clamp block 90 x 60 x 90, bored 60.5 on a centre 40 above its base,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then sawn across on the bore centre line; 2 M10 hold the cap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the lower half on the crossbeam centre, bore along the pit.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sleeve: 60.3 pipe 60 long bored to fit the extension, sawn in two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: along its length; used only when clamping the extension tube.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: stands on the far rim 100 back from the edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: bore centre 200 above the pad undersides.
